card.name: Time units after a number
card.fires_on: Time-unit words such as days, months, hours or weeks right after a number, giving a duration or deadline. Mostly in label text about monitoring, waiting periods or treatment length.

modes.label: Days after a number
modes.description: The word days follows a number that sets a period or deadline.
modes.example: Objections and requests for hearing can be submitted 30<< days>> after date of publication.

modes.label: Months or weeks after a number
modes.description: Months or weeks follow a number in post-dose or post-birth waiting periods.
modes.example: use effective contraception during treatment with OPDUALAG for at least 5<< months>> after the last dose of OPDUAL

modes.label: Hours or hyphenated month
modes.description: Hours, or a hyphenated month form, follows a number in timing statements.
modes.example: 48<< hours>> after the first infusion of RITUX
